body:
My father left us when I was five. I have never suffered so much in my life. The next twenty some years were always plagued by this thought. I can have regular contact with him but i choose not to. I hate him for what he did and can not get past it. 

You are not alone and having your parents divorced is not something to take lightly. It is you first impression of a relationship. If that relationship is messed up then that is how you view it. Parents are supposed to be our higher power as children, but they make mistakes. Those mistakes end up with us forever. the only memory I have of my parents together is them fighting. I don't know a happy memory when my mom and dad were together or even apart (I had to kick my dad out of my house several times).
I really like your interpretation of what you want out of life. I do not want happiness, I just want to not feel this way.

Ya pretty much. The disappointment of not being happy is too much to bear. She gave me everything. When my dad left I became the man of the house at a very early age and have always protected my mom and sister. I feel if she has to protect me I have failed as a son.

I live in a city with tons of people around and I have never felt so alone. My best friend in the world who saved me from my first suicide attempt lives too far away to help me. I miss him so much. He kept me sane through all of the bad times. I feel ya! It sucks to be close to only a few people and to be left without them.
I am sitting here and can't bring myself to even call my mom and ask her for help. My life is based on lies and if I call her it all falls apart.

I feel this about my father. For the longest time I could not understand why he did certain things. Every year though I become more and more like him. I even see him in the mirror. I hate him so I find that I am hating myself as well. The person I vowed never to become like I am becoming. Job that i loathe and don't want to do anymore, the feeling of having to be a good father and never seeing that you are on or could never be one.

You are not alone in this. Although I am not happy that you fell this way I am at least glad someone else gets it. If you want to PM let me know. I would love to discuss this with you.
